what_the_curves_show: Training and validation losses decreased overall for both models. Validation scores improved with some fluctuations. The baseline finished with lower validation loss.
augmentation_effect: The baseline achieved validation macro-F1 of 0.6740, compared with 0.6667 for augmentation. Augmentation did not improve macro-F1 in this 12-epoch experiment.
one_limitation: Only one random seed and one 12-epoch training budget were tested. The small performance difference may not generalize to other runs.
